```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite:** U20_3 - Patient Consultation and Lab Management

**Target System:** Patient Consultation and Lab Management System

**Test Objective:** Verify that the system functions as per the requirements.

**Test Scope:** Functional testing of the Patient Consultation and Lab Management System.

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Title | Requirement ID(s) | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Patient uploads report | VIRTUA-3-12 | Positive | Patient is logged in | report_file (5MB file) | Upload report | Report uploaded successfully |
| TC-002 | Offline reporting and email delivery | VIRTUA-3-11 | Positive | Offline mode enabled | N/A | Send report via email | Report sent successfully |
| TC-003 | Appointment creation and home specimen collection | VIRTUA-3-10 | Positive | N/A | Consultation details | Create appointment and schedule home collection | Appointment created and home collection scheduled |
| TC-004 | ML disease prediction and doctor acceptance/modification | VIRTUA-3-14, VIRTUA-3-15 | Positive | N/A | Symptoms | ML prediction and doctor review | Disease predicted and diagnosis accepted/modified |
| TC-005 | Boundary check for maximum reports per consultation | VIRTUA-3-12 | Boundary | N/A | Consultation details | Upload 6 reports | Error message indicating maximum limit reached |
| TC-006 | Boundary check for maximum file size | VIRTUA-3-12 | Boundary | N/A | Report file (5.1MB) | Upload report | Error message indicating maximum size exceeded |
| TC-007 | Lab routing by pincode | VIRTUA-3-9 | Positive | N/A | Patient pincode | Lab selection | Lab selected based on pincode |

```
